hypothesis_title: STR_1631_MEGA_ENSEMBLE — MEGA_03 60% + MEGA_05 40% Independent Sleeve Blend
hypothesis_description: Mega Sprint 5-Phase 종결 후 Judge L-221 권고 Option D Ensemble. MEGA_03 (Harvey FF5 2.79 최고, HRP rolling + Regime-Σ + 4F consensus) 60% sleeve + MEGA_05 (Full SR 1.258 최고, CRISIS SR 2.98 회복, 6F + Kelly f=0.5) 40% sleeve 독립 블렌딩. 가설: 두 best config의 orthogonal weakness 상쇄 → Harvey t_NW 2.79/2.69 → 3.0+ 달성, MDD -37~38% → -32% 이내, CRISIS SR 2.26/2.98 → 3.5+ 유지. 구조: 2-sleeve (Core 60% MEGA_03 14종목 + Tactical 40% MEGA_05 8~10종목 score-based 교집합 처리), n_total=20 hard, weight cap 15%, FM weighted cross-sleeve. TDC ≤ 0.40 검증 필수 (L-156 v2). LOO 검증 (각 sleeve out 영향). Blender agent 또는 Optimizer ensemble 방법론 자율 선택. Success: Harvey ≥3.0 MUST + MDD ≤32% TARGET + PG1 admission 자격. Kill: Harvey <2.79 (MEGA_03 baseline 이하) OR MDD >-40% OR TDC >0.50.
